summary: For the detections in one capture, return which pallets are sent through stage 2 and which are deferred. select_stage2_subset ranks the existing DetectionCandidate list with the strategy select_detection already implements, admits at most the count this capture will pose, and places every remaining candidate in deferred. Stage2Admission holds those two vectors, admitted and deferred, and each candidate keeps its source_index. The pose node calls it with its detection_selection strategy and a count of one, so stage 2 still estimates that single admitted pallet, and the other candidates in this array stay on the deferred vector for this capture. An empty candidate list returns both vectors empty, and an unknown strategy throws. The count is set for this capture because the scene can still change and stage 2 poses a subset of the array.
hypothesis: select_detection keeps only the winning candidate, so the detections this array did not send through stage 2 disappear before the handling process can see them. A Stage2Admission from that same ranking gives both sides of the split for this capture, and the caller chooses how many of the ranked candidates are admitted.
